NUM 28:14.text: Their drink offerings shall be half a hin of wine with each bull, a third of a hin with the ram, and a quarter hin with each lamb. This is the monthly burnt offering to be made at each new moon throughout the year.

NUM 28:15.text: In addition to the regular burnt offering with its drink offering, one male goat is to be presented to the LORD as a sin offering.

NUM 28:3.text: And tell them that this is the offering made by fire you are to present to the LORD as a regular burnt offering each day: two unblemished year-old male lambs.

NUM 28:4.text: Offer one lamb in the morning and the other at twilight,

NUM 28:5.text: along with a tenth of an ephah of fine flour as a grain offering, mixed with a quarter hin of oil from pressed olives.

NUM 28:6.text: This is a regular burnt offering established at Mount Sinai as a pleasing aroma, an offering made by fire to the LORD.

NUM 28:7.text: The drink offering accompanying each lamb shall be a quarter hin. Pour out the offering of fermented drink to the LORD in the sanctuary area.

NUM 28:8.text: And offer the second lamb at twilight, with the same grain offering and drink offering as in the morning. It is an offering made by fire, a pleasing aroma to the LORD.

NUM 28:9.text: On the Sabbath day, present two unblemished year-old male lambs, accompanied by a grain offering of two-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil, as well as a drink offering.

NUM 6:24.text: ‘May the LORD bless you and keep you;

NUM 6:25.text: may the LORD cause His face to shine upon you and be gracious to you;

NUM 6:26.text: may the LORD lift up His countenance toward you and give you peace.’

PSA 113:1.text: Hallelujah! Give praise, O servants of the LORD; praise the name of the LORD.

PSA 92:1.text: It is good to praise the LORD, and to sing praises to Your name, O Most High,

ZEC 7:1.text: In the fourth year of King Darius, the word of the LORD came to Zechariah on the fourth day of the ninth month, the month of Chislev.
